derivation.method: axe.getRules() on the pinned vendored artifact, offline, at seed-authoring time (LLD 3A-1 §3)
derivation.id_assignment: engine rule ids sorted lexicographically, numbered PLM-A11Y-001.. — FROZEN, never renumbered
derivation.capability_note: All seeded rules are engine-automated -> AUTO. The HUMAN_WITH_CANDIDATE population (incomplete-prone rules) arrives with the result-processor Class-3 feed as lifecycle version bumps — not fabricated at seed time.

acc05_cross_list.status: ACC-05 = the R1 automated rule list (requirements baseline: 'ACC-05/06 automated ... rule lists stand'). Mapped set-wide: every seeded AUTO rule. The v1 per-item list is not present in repo-held docs; the item-level cross-list completes when AK supplies it.

derivation.set_review_principle: D3 claim_set analog: set-level human review (this fixture's PR) with per-item inspectability (line-reviewable).

rules.name: Active <area> elements must have alternative text
rules.description: Ensure <area> elements of image maps have alternative text

rules.name: Elements must only use supported ARIA attributes
rules.description: Ensure an element's role supports its ARIA attributes

rules.name: aria-braille attributes must have a non-braille equivalent
rules.description: Ensure aria-braillelabel and aria-brailleroledescription have a non-braille equivalent

rules.name: ARIA commands must have an accessible name
rules.description: Ensure every ARIA button, link and menuitem has an accessible name

rules.name: ARIA attributes must be used as specified for the element's role
rules.description: Ensure ARIA attributes are used as described in the specification of the element's role

rules.name: Deprecated ARIA roles must not be used
rules.description: Ensure elements do not use deprecated roles

rules.name: aria-hidden="true" must not be present on the document body
rules.description: Ensure aria-hidden="true" is not present on the document body.

rules.name: ARIA hidden element must not be focusable or contain focusable elements
rules.description: Ensure aria-hidden elements are not focusable nor contain focusable elements

rules.name: ARIA input fields must have an accessible name
rules.description: Ensure every ARIA input field has an accessible name

rules.name: ARIA meter nodes must have an accessible name
rules.description: Ensure every ARIA meter node has an accessible name

rules.name: ARIA progressbar nodes must have an accessible name
rules.description: Ensure every ARIA progressbar node has an accessible name

rules.name: Elements must only use permitted ARIA attributes
rules.description: Ensure ARIA attributes are not prohibited for an element's role

rules.name: Required ARIA attributes must be provided
rules.description: Ensure elements with ARIA roles have all required ARIA attributes

rules.name: Certain ARIA roles must contain particular children
rules.description: Ensure elements with an ARIA role that require child roles contain them

rules.name: Certain ARIA roles must be contained by particular parents
rules.description: Ensure elements with an ARIA role that require parent roles are contained by them

rules.name: aria-roledescription must be on elements with a semantic role
rules.description: Ensure aria-roledescription is only used on elements with an implicit or explicit role

rules.name: ARIA roles used must conform to valid values
rules.description: Ensure all elements with a role attribute use a valid value

rules.name: ARIA tab nodes must have an accessible name
rules.description: Ensure every ARIA tab node has an accessible name

rules.name: ARIA toggle fields must have an accessible name
rules.description: Ensure every ARIA toggle field has an accessible name

rules.name: ARIA tooltip nodes must have an accessible name
rules.description: Ensure every ARIA tooltip node has an accessible name

rules.name: ARIA attributes must conform to valid names
rules.description: Ensure attributes that begin with aria- are valid ARIA attributes

rules.name: ARIA attributes must conform to valid values
rules.description: Ensure all ARIA attributes have valid values

rules.name: <audio> elements must have a captions track
rules.description: Ensure <audio> elements have captions

rules.name: autocomplete attribute must be used correctly
rules.description: Ensure the autocomplete attribute is correct and suitable for the form field

rules.name: Inline text spacing must be adjustable with custom stylesheets
rules.description: Ensure that text spacing set through style attributes can be adjusted with custom stylesheets

rules.name: <blink> elements are deprecated and must not be used
rules.description: Ensure <blink> elements are not used

rules.name: Buttons must have discernible text
rules.description: Ensure buttons have discernible text

rules.name: Page must have means to bypass repeated blocks
rules.description: Ensure each page has at least one mechanism for a user to bypass navigation and jump straight to the content

rules.name: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
rules.description: Ensure the contrast between foreground and background colors meets WCAG 2 AA minimum contrast ratio thresholds

rules.name: Elements must meet enhanced color contrast ratio thresholds
rules.description: Ensure the contrast between foreground and background colors meets WCAG 2 AAA enhanced contrast ratio thresholds

rules.name: <dl> elements must only directly contain properly-ordered <dt> and <dd> groups, <script>, <template> or <div> elements
rules.description: Ensure <dl> elements are structured correctly

rules.name: <dt> and <dd> elements must be contained by a <dl>
rules.description: Ensure <dt> and <dd> elements are contained by a <dl>

rules.name: Documents must have <title> element to aid in navigation
rules.description: Ensure each HTML document contains a non-empty <title> element

rules.name: IDs used in ARIA and labels must be unique
rules.description: Ensure every id attribute value used in ARIA and in labels is unique

rules.name: Form field must not have multiple label elements
rules.description: Ensure form field does not have multiple label elements

rules.name: Frames with focusable content must not have tabindex=-1
rules.description: Ensure <frame> and <iframe> elements with focusable content do not have tabindex=-1

rules.name: Frames must have an accessible name
rules.description: Ensure <iframe> and <frame> elements have an accessible name

rules.name: Frames must have a unique title attribute
rules.description: Ensure <iframe> and <frame> elements contain a unique title attribute

rules.name: <html> element must have a lang attribute
rules.description: Ensure every HTML document has a lang attribute

rules.name: <html> element must have a valid value for the lang attribute
rules.description: Ensure the lang attribute of the <html> element has a valid value

rules.name: HTML elements with lang and xml:lang must have the same base language
rules.description: Ensure that HTML elements with both valid lang and xml:lang attributes agree on the base language of the page

rules.name: Links with the same name must have a similar purpose
rules.description: Ensure that links with the same accessible name serve a similar purpose

rules.name: Images must have alternative text
rules.description: Ensure elements have alternative text or a role of none or presentation

rules.name: Input buttons must have discernible text
rules.description: Ensure input buttons have discernible text

rules.name: Image buttons must have alternative text
rules.description: Ensure <input type="image"> elements have alternative text

rules.name: Form elements must have labels
rules.description: Ensure every form element has a label

rules.name: Links must be distinguishable without relying on color
rules.description: Ensure links are distinguished from surrounding text in a way that does not rely on color

rules.name: Links must have discernible text
rules.description: Ensure links have discernible text

rules.name: <ul> and <ol> must only directly contain <li>, <script> or <template> elements
rules.description: Ensure that lists are structured correctly

rules.name: <li> elements must be contained in a <ul> or <ol>
rules.description: Ensure <li> elements are used semantically

rules.name: <marquee> elements are deprecated and must not be used
rules.description: Ensure <marquee> elements are not used

rules.name: Delayed refresh under 20 hours must not be used
rules.description: Ensure <meta http-equiv="refresh"> is not used for delayed refresh

rules.name: Delayed refresh must not be used
rules.description: Ensure <meta http-equiv="refresh"> is not used for delayed refresh

rules.name: Zooming and scaling must not be disabled
rules.description: Ensure <meta name="viewport"> does not disable text scaling and zooming

rules.name: Interactive controls must not be nested
rules.description: Ensure interactive controls are not nested as they are not always announced by screen readers or can cause focus problems for assistive technologies

rules.name: <video> or <audio> elements must not play automatically
rules.description: Ensure <video> or <audio> elements do not autoplay audio for more than 3 seconds without a control mechanism to stop or mute the audio

rules.name: <object> elements must have alternative text
rules.description: Ensure <object> elements have alternative text

rules.name: [role="img"] and [role="image"] elements must have alternative text
rules.description: Ensure [role="img"] and [role="image"] elements have alternative text

rules.name: Scrollable region must have keyboard access
rules.description: Ensure elements that have scrollable content are accessible by keyboard in Safari

rules.name: Select element must have an accessible name
rules.description: Ensure select element has an accessible name

rules.name: Server-side image maps must not be used
rules.description: Ensure that server-side image maps are not used

rules.name: Summary elements must have discernible text
rules.description: Ensure summary elements have discernible text

rules.name: <svg> elements with an img or image role must have alternative text
rules.description: Ensure <svg> elements with an img, image, graphics-document or graphics-symbol role have accessible text

rules.name: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space
rules.description: Ensure touch targets have sufficient size and space

rules.name: Table cell headers attributes must refer to other <th> elements in the same table
rules.description: Ensure that each cell in a table that uses the headers attribute refers only to other <th> elements in that table

rules.name: Table headers in a data table must refer to data cells
rules.description: Ensure that <th> elements and elements with role=columnheader/rowheader have data cells they describe

rules.name: lang attribute must have a valid value
rules.description: Ensure lang attributes have valid values

rules.name: <video> elements must have captions
rules.description: Ensure <video> elements have captions
